feature: Static JSON mirror of Bible text, generated from /bible-sources/*.sqlite files, deployed as Pages static assets at /static-data/

tasks.title: Read BUILD_STATE.json, ARCHITECTURE.md, and the existing D1 import script to understand schema-mapping logic, repo tooling conventions, and which versions exist in /bible-sources/ and D1. Create STATIC_MIRROR_STATE.json seeded with this task list. Commit, push, verify push on origin/main.
Design the exact /static-data/ directory layout and JSON shape (reusing the Worker API's chapter response shape). Document it in ARCHITECTURE.md.
Write the generator script: reads one .sqlite file, reuses/mirrors the existing schema-mapping logic, writes that version's full /static-data/{version}/... tree, idempotent on rerun.
Run the generator locally against every version currently in /bible-sources/ and commit the resulting /static-data/ tree.

Add the generator as a step in the existing GitHub Actions workflow, running for every file in /bible-sources/ on every relevant trigger, independent of and unblocked by the D1 import step's quota state.
Confirm the static JSON tree is actually deployed and fetchable from the live Pages URL after a real deploy.
Integrate the static mirror into the Reader page with fallback to the Worker API preserved. Verify the site still renders identically to before.
Add the static-mirror documentation section to the existing API docs page.

Run the full first-priority verification list against the live site: matching output vs Worker API, live fetchability, Reader page behavior, the queued-behind-quota-version-already-readable-statically case, and confirmation the existing D1/Worker pipeline is unaffected. Fix anything broken. Only once every task is genuinely done and verified live, mark feature_complete: true, commit, and push.

resume_from: task-01: read existing scripts (import.py, apply_d1.py), worker/index.js response shape, deploy.yml, site/app.js; then mark task-01 done and proceed to task-02.
